name: Gharelu Hinsa Ki Pidita Ke Liye Sahayta Yojana
benefit: **The victim will be assisted as follows** 1. If the disabilities of less than 40% resulting from damage to any part of the body, compensation of up to ₹2,00,000/- will be provided. 1. If the disability exceeds 40% due to damage to any part of the body, the compensation increases to a maximum of ₹4,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant must be women and girls only.
- The applicant must be affected by domestic violence.
